title: Controller settings
prompt: Move the indicated control, then release:
bind: Controller bindings (select and press a control, or type a0, -a1, b0 or a pair separated by a comma)
unknown: Standard layout active. Remap controls in settings.
keyboardHelp: Layout: {layout}. Select a binding and press the new key.
keyReset: Restore default keys for this layout
negative: Release, then press the control for the opposite direction.
